summary: Rahul Sankrityayan was an Indologist, Buddhist studies scholar, and Tibetologist. He taught at Vidyalankara Pirivena in 1927 and held teaching and professorial posts at Saint Petersburg State University and its Faculty of Oriental Studies between 1937 and 1947.

Raimo Anttila was a scholar of linguistics and Indology. He studied at Yale University under Warren Crawford Cowgill from around 1961 to 1966, later holding posts at the University of California, Los Angeles (1965) and the University of Helsinki (1971–1976).

Raimon Panikkar worked in religious studies, philosophy, and Indology. After studying at Barcelona, Bonn, Complutense University of Madrid under Juan Zaragüeta, Mysore, BHU, and the Lateran University, he held posts at Madrid (1946–1953), Harvard (1966–1971), and UC Santa Barbara (1971–1978).

Raimond Gaita is a philosopher who studied at the University of Melbourne and the University of Leeds. He held positions at King's College London (1977–2011), Australian Catholic University (1993–2011), and the University of Melbourne (2019).

Raj Ballav Panda is an Indology scholar who earned degrees from Rajendra University, Centurion University, and Banaras Hindu University (Ph.D. 2022). He held faculty posts at Rajendra University (2018) and Klorofeel School (2022).
Raja Pathak is an Indologist who completed a Ph.D. at Banaras Hindu University between 2014 and 2020. He has held a post at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University.

Raja Ram Shastri worked in Indology and other fields. He served as a Member of the Lok Sabha from circa 1971 to 1977 and was Chairman of the Managing Committee at Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri National Sanskrit University around 1976.

Raja Rao was a philosopher and Indologist who studied at Aligarh Muslim University, Madras, Montpellier, Paris, and under Krishna Menon Atmananda. He taught at the University of Texas at Austin from circa 1966 to 1983.

Rajan Gurukkal is a historian and Indologist who studied at the University of Calicut and JNU. His career includes posts at JNU, Mahatma Gandhi University (Director from 1988), and the Indian Institute of Science (Visiting Professor 2012–2016).

Rajan Khatiwoda is an Indologist and historian who earned his PhD at Heidelberg University (2013–2017). Since 2017, he has held posts at Heidelberg University and the Heidelberg Academy of Sciences and Humanities.
Rajaram Hegde is a scholar of history, archaeology, and religious studies. In 2010, he was attested as Director at Kuvempu University and the Centre for the Study of Local Cultures.

Rajat Pal is a scholar of philosophy and Indology who studied at Gurukula Kangri Vishwavidyalaya and pursued a Ph.D. at the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (2022–2026), where he also held a post.
Rajat Verma works in the fields of computational studies and Indology. He has held posts at the Indian Institute of Technology Mandi and BharatGen.

Rajeev Kinra is an Indologist and historian who completed his PhD at the University of Chicago (1999–2008), where he also held a post in 1999. In 2007, he became an Associate Professor at Northwestern University.

Rajeev Kumar is a scholar of philosophy, religious studies, and Buddhist studies. He earned a PhD from Panjab University in 2013, where he served as a UGC Research Fellow, and later became Assistant Professor at the University of Delhi.

Rajeev Sangal is a researcher in computational fields, linguistics, and Indology. He studied at IIT Kanpur and the University of Pennsylvania, and held posts at IIT Kanpur (1982–1998), IIIT Hyderabad (2002–2013, 2018–2022), and IIT (BHU) Varanasi (2013–2018).

Rajendra Chandra Hazra was an Indologist who studied at the University of Dhaka under Sushil Kumar De. He held teaching posts at Jagannath University (1931), the University of Dhaka (1939–1951), and Sanskrit College and University (1951–1972).

Rajendrakumar Dabee is a scholar of philosophy and Indology who studied at the University of Mauritius, Bharathidasan University, and the University of Madras. He worked at the Ministry of Education (1993–2013) and Mahatma Gandhi Institute (Senior Lecturer 2013).

Rajendralal Mitra was an Indologist and historian who studied at Calcutta Medical College and the University of Calcutta. He served at The Asiatic Society as librarian-cum-assistant-secretary (1846–1856) and president (1885), and directed the Wards' Institution (1856–1881).

Rajesh Kochhar was a historian and Indologist who completed an M.Sc. and Ph.D. at Panjab University. He served as Professor at the Indian Institute of Astrophysics (1991–2017) and Director of NISTADS (1991–2006).
